title: Permissions-Policy grants a Privacy Sandbox API to every origin
description: The Permissions-Policy value opens an advertising or measurement API (browsing-topics, attribution-reporting, join-ad-interest-group, run-ad-auction, private-aggregation or shared-storage) to every origin with `*`. Embedded third-party frames can then enrol the top-level page in interest grouping or attribution reporting without the operator naming the party that does it.
remediation: Leave Privacy Sandbox APIs disabled unless the product needs them, and where they are needed name the exact origins in the allowlist instead of `*`.
limitation: One header value. The check reads the declared allowlist only; it does not observe interest groups or attribution reports, and browser support for each API differs, so a reported delegation may have no effect in some user agents.
